text:
Al gold of your brow unos carnations

I see matizar, cruentos, with heridas;

ellos mueren of love, and a nuestras vidas

his amenazas les avisan faithful.


Rúbricas are piadosas, and crueles,

joyas facinorosas, and advertidas,

pues publicando muertes florecidas,

ensangrientan al sun rizos doseles.


Mas with your lips quedan vergonzosos

(that no compiten flowers a rubíes)

and pálidos después, of temerosos.


and when with relámpagos you ríes

of púrpura, cobardes, if ambiciosos,

marchitan his blasones carmesíes.

translation.title: A Flori, that had unos carnations among the hair blond
